detail.longDescription: FAIR has joined the Science|Business Network – a leading European network linking research, universities, industry & policy-makers to strengthen R&I collaboration. As a member, FAIR reinforces cross-border, cross-sector cooperation. A joint policy workshop is already in preparation. More 👉 https://www. gsi.de/en/start/news/details/2 026/08/28/science-business-network © D. Fehrenz, GSI/FAIR # Darmstadt # Science # Research # Europe
